title: Worker Cooperative Startup Webinar
description: A free monthly 90-minute Zoom webinar from the U.S. Federation of Worker Cooperatives for groups and people at the very earliest stages of a worker cooperative project — the key steps toward getting off the ground, where problems often occur, and chapters on building a group's democratic capacity, business, and environment of support, in a participatory conversational format. Attendees are offered 30 minutes of free consulting from USFWC afterwards. Free, with no membership requirement stated on the registration page — one of the lowest-barrier entry points in this directory. Presented in English; USFWC posts Spanish-language sessions separately on its calendar. Donations optional.

recurrence.schedule: First Wednesday of every month, 3pm ET (12pm PT), 90 minutes on Zoom. Register for each session from USFWC's calendar.
